A few balls to find your feet

Meet the ball

Aim the ring at the point where you want to meet the ball. Hold to prepare the bat, then swipe. Your aim stays in place while the blade moves through it. The middle of the stroke meter is the contact zone.

MouseMove the contact ring across the crease and up or down. Place it before you start the stroke. LMB + swipeSwipe up for a drive; diagonally to angle it; sideways for a cut, pull or low sweep. A quicker swipe gives more bat speed. Release after contact to follow through. RMBHold for a soft-handed block. Move the blade to meet the ball, or move it aside to leave. 123Choose Grounded, Lofted or Defend. With Defend selected, hold the mouse or touch to block. You can also use the three buttons beside Next ball. Fine adjustmentAD adjust the face, WS adjust loft, and QE adjust blade roll. C clears these adjustments. Shot shape works without them. Space PBowl the next ball · pause or resume. Conditions apply to the next delivery.

Touch: place a finger at the contact point, then swipe up or across. Select Defend for a block. Try half speed and middle-stump deliveries while learning. The ball and bat keep their physical width; the game does not aim for you.
